_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: one rank rule (from the last, or the total); 2: a rank found in two steps, a row of five, or people put in order of height; 3: a circle of five or six to build from three clues, digits or letters sorted and compared, or a rule checked against a number; 4: two facing rows of six from many clues, or a number built digit by digit from clues. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
